name: Natsuzora no Perseus
source:
Shinra and his younger sister Ren have the ability to transfer 'pain' on to themselves by touching someone. Ever since they were young, they have been used by their foster parents for this ability. Tired of constantly moving from place to place, they decided to leave together to the rural mountain village of Tenryou-mura with the intention of not using their powers again. Even though they can temporarily lessen pain by taking it from someone, they are unable to cure whatever is causing the pain. However, his mother had told him that his ability is a gift for someone special in his life.

Their distant relative Sui greeted them and showed them around the school, where they met the bookworm Ayame and Touka, who had an angelic smile. They are the only students at the school and this suited the siblings just fine since they wanted to avoid contact with people as much as possible. Gradually, he learned about the 'pain' that each girl had. Sui had an injured leg, while Ayame suffered from her parent's deaths in a traffic accident. His own sister Ren didn't trust anyone, relying only on him. However, Touka's pain is on a totally different scale – just touching her had pain shooting through his body. This is the beginning of a tale of love and sacrifice.

[Edited from [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/12/01/december-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
深罗和他的妹妹莲拥有通过触碰他人将“痛苦”转移到自己身上的能力。从小到大，他们一直被养父母利用这种能力。厌倦了不断搬来搬去的生活，他们决定一起离开，前往偏远的山村天领村，打算再也不使用这种能力。虽然他们可以通过承受他人的痛苦来暂时减轻疼痛，但无法治愈导致疼痛的根本原因。然而，母亲曾告诉他，他的能力是送给生命中某个特别之人的礼物。

他们的远房亲戚翠迎接了他们，并带他们参观了学校，在那里他们遇到了书虫菖蒲和有着天使般微笑的冬华。她们是学校里仅有的学生，这对兄妹来说正合心意，因为他们想尽可能避免与人接触。渐渐地，他了解到每个女孩所承受的“痛苦”。翠的腿受了伤，而菖蒲因父母在车祸中去世而痛苦。他自己的妹妹莲不信任任何人，只依赖他。然而，冬华的痛苦完全是另一个量级的——仅仅是触碰她就让他的全身涌过剧痛。这是一个关于爱与牺牲的故事的开始。

[编辑自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/12/01/december-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
